Candidate v4.1 refines relational rule classification and question materiality; legacy v4.0/default, schema, audit and expectations preserved. Route one uniform version across runtime/replay without rewriting bad outputs. Efficacy unobserved. Subsequent PO judgment recorded in DOC-0062: three available outputs PASS, conflict uncertainty FAIL; four cases unavailable. Historical pending review is superseded only by these scoped new assessments, not rewritten. Budget closed and incidents unresolved.
